test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the appropriate meaning of the underlying idiom.**

They __got into hot water__ when their tricks were revealed by their neighbour.
solution:
The correct answer is:** Landed in trouble**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "**got into hot water**" means to get into trouble or face consequences.
 
• This idiom is often used when someone has done something wrong or made a mistake.
 
• The phrase "hot water" is used metaphorically to represent a difficult or unpleasant situation.
 
• In this context, the neighbours revealed the tricks of the people, which caused them to **land in trouble** or face consequences.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.
